versions.changelog:
Third and final pass on the security findings: the TUI was building shell commands out of listing URLs.

最后一轮安全修复：TUI 曾把房源链接拼进 shell 命令。

openExternal() passed its argument to exec() as a template string with only double quotes escaped. Several call sites hand it listing URLs and file paths read out of reports — scraped data — so a URL containing ; ... or $(...) or backticks would have run as a shell command. Quoting is not a defence against shell syntax; not involving a shell is.

openExternal() 把参数拼进 exec() 的模板字符串，只转义了双引号。多个调用点传入的是抓取来的房源链接与报告里的文件路径，因此链接里含 ; ...、$(...) 或反引号就会被当作 shell 命令执行。加引号挡不住 shell 语法，正确做法是不经过 shell。

Now: execFile with an argument array, so nothing is ever parsed by a shell. Plus an allow-list — http(s) goes to your browser, files must resolve inside the repo and exist, and any other scheme (javascript:, smb://, ...) is refused with a message.

现在：改用 execFile 传参数数组，参数永不经过 shell；另加白名单——http(s) 交给浏览器，文件必须解析后仍落在仓库内且真实存在，其它 scheme 一律拒绝并提示。

Also: the map regeneration call was exec("node <path>") too; it is now execFile(process.execPath, [...]), which also stops depending on node being on PATH.

另外：重新生成地图的那次调用原先也是 exec("node <path>")，现改为 execFile(process.execPath, [...])，顺带不再依赖 PATH 上的 node。

selftest runs the real openExternal against hostile input (12 cases): normal URLs and in-repo files still open, while '; rm -rf /', '$(whoami)', backticks, javascript:, smb://, out-of-repo paths and missing files are all refused. Disabling the allow-list makes three assertions fail.

自测跑真实的 openExternal 喂恶意输入（12 例）：正常 URL 与仓库内文件照常打开，而 '; rm -rf /'、'$(whoami)'、反引号、javascript:、smb://、仓库外路径、不存在的文件全部被拒。去掉白名单会让 3 条断言失败。

This package 1.0.8 = repo v0.3.1 + commits f8acbc0, bf874f8, 42cc61b.

Second pass on generated-page safety. 1.0.6 cleared the two static findings; this clears what the LLM review caught after it.

1.0.6 清掉了静态扫描的两条；这一版修的是随后 LLM 复核发现的部分。

The first fix only escaped the house list, because that is where the scanner pointed. Auditing the whole page turned up more raw interpolations: the compare matrix header and rows (report number, total price, estimated tax, unit price, area, year built, district, type, tag class), the Leaflet marker labels (community name, total price, score), and the compare chip. All now go through esc().

第一版只转义了房源列表（因为扫描器只指了那里）。全文件复查后发现更多未转义插值：对比矩阵的表头与各行（编号、总价、预估税费、单价、面积、房龄、板块、类型、标签档）、Leaflet marker 标签（小区名、总价、评分）、以及对比 chip。现已全部转义。

One case could not be fixed by escaping: the compare chip interpolated a report number into an inline onclick="toggleCompareItem('...')". HTML entities are decoded before the attribute reaches JavaScript, so esc() output like ' turns back into a quote and still closes the JS string. That handler is replaced with a data attribute and a real click listener, so no data is ever concatenated into JS source.

其中一处无法靠转义修复：对比 chip 把房源编号拼进了内联 onclick。HTML 实体在属性值送达 JS 之前就被解码，因此 esc() 产出的 ' 会还原为引号并照样闭合 JS 字符串。该 handler 已改为 data 属性 + 真实事件监听，数据不再被拼接进 JS 源码。

The selftest assertions now scan the entire page source rather than the single function that was reported, check each field by exact name, skip textContent assignments, and reject inline handlers carrying an interpolation outright.

自测断言改为扫描整份页面源码（而非当初被报告的那一个函数），按完整字段名核对，跳过 textContent 赋值，并对带插值的内联 handler 直接判失败。

Note: ClawHub versioning is independent from the repo. This package 1.0.7 = repo v0.3.1 + commits f8acbc0, bf874f8.
注意：ClawHub 版本号与仓库独立。本包 1.0.7 对应仓库 v0.3.1 之后的状态。

Security: the map no longer runs a local server at all, and the house list escapes every listing field it renders.

Two findings from ClawHub's scan (AI-Infra-Guard T09), both fixed by removing surface rather than guarding it:
- scripts/map.mjs: the map server bound every interface and its POST /api/profile and /api/geo-cache would rewrite config/profile.yml with no authentication, on top of Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. The server is gone. The map is now only a single self-contained HTML file with the data inlined: nothing listens, nothing accepts writes. --serve remains as a message explaining the change.
- scripts/lib/map-page.mjs: renderHouseList interpolated community, report number, tags and the district/type line raw into innerHTML — stored XSS, since those come from scraped listings. All fields now go through esc(), which additionally covers quotes so attribute contexts cannot be broken out of either.

Changing your buyer profile now means exporting YAML from the page and handing it back to your agent. Writing files is the agent's job, not the page's.

同步安全修复：地图不再启动任何本地服务，房源列表对所有展示字段做 HTML 转义。
改动 profile 的方式改为：页面导出 YAML → 交回 agent 写回。写文件是 agent 的活。

Note: ClawHub versioning is independent from the repo. This package 1.0.6 corresponds to repo v0.3.1 + commit f8acbc0.
注意：ClawHub 版本号与仓库独立。本包 1.0.6 对应仓库 v0.3.1 之后的状态（提交 f8acbc0）。
Syncs repo v0.3.1 (first tag matching the current tree). Adds a Codex plugin manifest, keeps the skill folder self-contained. 同步仓库 v0.3.1：新增 Codex 插件清单，技能目录保持自包含。

精简分发包：docs/ 只保留运行时真正引用的 markets/（欧洲/亚太市场手册），去掉 1.8MB 的地图截图、虚构样例、ADR 与仓库协作文档；打包脚本移出 scripts/，不再进用户机器。包体 2.4MB → 640KB。含 1.0.3 的 data/ reports/ 占位修复。/ Trim the package: docs/ now ships only markets/, the path SKILL.md actually cites. Dropped 1.8MB of screenshots plus samples, ADRs and repo docs. The packaging script moved out of scripts/ so it no longer lands on user machines. 2.4MB -> 640KB. Includes the 1.0.3 data/ reports/ placeholder fix.

1.0.2 的修补：补齐 data/ 与 reports/ 占位目录——空目录在打包传输中会被丢弃，导致装过去没有写报告和扫描记录的地方。其余同 1.0.2（技能目录镜像仓库，npx skills add 与 clawhub install 均装出完整实现层）。/ Fixes 1.0.2: ship the data/ and reports/ placeholders. Empty directories are dropped during transfer, so an installed copy had nowhere to write reports or scan records. Otherwise identical to 1.0.2.

自包含安装：技能目录现在镜像仓库（modes/ scripts/ scrapers/ templates/ config/ docs/），npx skills add 与 clawhub install 装出来的都是完整实现层，不再是只有一个 SKILL.md 的空壳。Project Root 解析加了 fallback，装进受管技能目录也能定位到自身。/ Self-contained install: the skill folder now mirrors the repository, so both npx skills add and clawhub install ship the full implementation instead of a lone SKILL.md. Root resolution gained a fallback for managed skill directories.

中英双份文案：SKILL.md 的 description 改为「中文段 + English 段」完整对照（两侧都带触发条件），展示名带上 slogan「驱动 agent，帮你把房选好 / Drive your agent, choose the right home」。/ Bilingual copy: SKILL.md description now ships a full Chinese block plus an English block, each with its own trigger conditions; display name adds the tagline. No functional change.

First public release: 13 modes (intake → triage → scan → evaluate → deep-dive → compare → visit → negotiate → contract → watchlist / stats / doctor), a zero-dependency Node >=18 script layer and an Ink TUI console. Every figure carries a source tag; listings that cannot be verified are voided, not downgraded.
